subject: Science
title: Class 10 Science Olympiad — Paper 2
instructions: The time allowed for this paper is 60 minutes.
This paper contains 50 objective-type (multiple-choice) questions carrying a total of 60 marks.
There is no negative marking for wrong answers.
Each question has four options; choose the one correct answer.
Section 1 and other regular sections carry 1 mark per question; the Achievers Section carries 3 marks per question.
Use of calculators is not permitted unless specified.

questions.question: If 8 machines produce 480 units in a day, how many units will 12 machines produce in a day at the same rate?
If '×' means '+', '+' means '-', '-' means '÷', and '÷' means '×', evaluate: 10 + 5 - 2
Find the next term: 3, 6, 11, 18, 27, __
If in a code LIGHT is written as MJHIU, how is SOUND written?
Five friends are sitting in a row. Raj is to the left of Simran but right of Aman. Simran is to the left of Priya. Who is in the middle?
Arrange in logical order: Egg, Larva, Pupa, Adult, Caterpillar
A is taller than B. C is shorter than B but taller than D. Who is the shortest?
If North-East becomes North, what does South-West become?
A clock reads 9:00. What is the angle between the hour and minute hands?
Find the next shape/number pattern: 1, 4, 9, 16, __ (squares of natural numbers)
Which of these is a non-renewable source of energy?
A wire of resistivity rho is stretched to double its length with volume constant. How does its resistance change?
A cell has a shorter life span in humans and lacks a nucleus; which cell is being described?
If the earth did not have a magnetic field, what would be a likely consequence?
options: Harmful cosmic and solar radiation would reach Earth's surface more easily

questions.question: Which process in plants converts light energy into chemical energy?
What is the function of the ozone layer?
Which element has the electronic configuration 2, 8, 7?
What is the pH range of acidic solutions?
Which gas is evolved when a metal reacts with a dilute acid?
A metal reacts vigorously with cold water forming a hydroxide and hydrogen gas with fire. Which metal fits this description?
During electrolysis of water, which gas is collected in double the volume at one electrode?
Which of the following is a exothermic reaction?
Which law states that the current through a conductor is directly proportional to the potential difference across it?
Which metal is extracted from bauxite ore?
A concave mirror produces an image that is virtual, erect and magnified. Where must the object be placed?
options: Between the pole and the focus

questions.question: Which vitamin deficiency causes scurvy?
Which hormone regulates blood sugar level in humans?
A patient's blood does not clot properly due to lack of a certain mineral in diet. Which mineral is most likely deficient?
Which gas is responsible for the greenhouse effect predominantly?
Which part of the eye controls the amount of light entering it?
Why is a food chain usually limited to 4-5 trophic levels?
options: Consumers cannot digest energy beyond 4 levels
Energy decreases at each successive trophic level

questions.question: A ray of light passes from air into glass. What happens to its speed and how does it bend relative to the normal?
options: Speed decreases and it bends towards the normal
Speed increases and it bends away from the normal
Speed decreases and it bends away from the normal
Speed remains the same and it does not bend

questions.question: Why does the sky appear blue during the daytime?
options: Absorption of red light by the atmosphere
Reflection of oceans onto the sky
Scattering of shorter wavelengths of light by atmospheric particles

questions.question: Why do stomata usually close at night?
options: To reduce water loss when photosynthesis is not occurring
To allow more carbon dioxide entry for respiration only
To increase the rate of photosynthesis

questions.question: In a food web, what would likely happen to the population of grasshoppers if all frogs (their predators) were removed?
Which of the following is the most reactive metal among these?
Two resistors of 4 ohm and 6 ohm are connected in series across a 10V battery. What is the current flowing through the circuit?
Which part of the human body is the site of complete digestion of food?
What is the general formula of alkanes?
A student observes bubbles of gas when zinc granules are added to dilute sulphuric acid, and the test tube becomes warm. What type of reaction is this?
What is the SI unit of electrical resistance?
Which factor explains why LPG combustion is preferred over burning coal for a cleaner environment?
options: Coal does not release carbon dioxide
LPG produces fewer particulate pollutants and burns more completely

questions.question: A solution turns red litmus blue. What can be concluded about the solution?
options: It is a salt solution only

questions.question: How does the eye adjust to focus on objects at varying distances?
options: The retina moves forward and backward
The ciliary muscles change the curvature/focal length of the eye lens

questions.question: If the image formed by a convex lens is always smaller than the object, virtual and erect, what can be concluded about the lens?
options: The object is between F and 2F
This never happens for a convex lens with a real object

questions.question: A student sets up a circuit with two bulbs in parallel and one in series with the parallel combination. If one of the parallel bulbs fuses, what happens to the other bulb in that parallel branch and the series bulb?
options: The other parallel bulb keeps glowing, the series bulb also keeps glowing (dimmer)
Only the series bulb stops glowing

questions.question: A wire carrying current is placed in a magnetic field and experiences a force. If the current direction is reversed, predict what happens to the direction of the force.
options: The direction of force reverses (by the right-hand/Fleming's left-hand rule)
The force remains in the same direction

questions.question: A student notices that touching a hot object leads to immediate withdrawal of the hand before the sensation of pain is even felt. Which biological concept explains this?
options: Involuntary action controlled by the cerebellum
Voluntary action controlled by the cerebrum
Hormonal response via the endocrine system
Reflex action, controlled by the spinal cord bypassing the brain initially

questions.question: A student is given an unknown white powder that turns red litmus blue and reacts with dilute HCl to release a colourless, odourless gas that turns lime water milky. Identify the possible compound.
Explain why deforestation in a region leads to a decrease in rainfall over time.
options: Trees have no role in the water cycle
Fewer trees reduce transpiration, lowering atmospheric moisture and disrupting the local water cycle
